subject.title: fix(memory): report indexed vector store in status

question: Should plain `memory status` report prior successful vector indexing from persisted `vectorDims`, while `--deep` remains the live sqlite-vec readiness probe?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and tested, but the user-visible CLI/JSON status meaning changes from live-process readiness to metadata-backed indexed readiness on the fast path.

options.title: Accept Metadata-Backed Fast Status
options.body: Land this PR if maintainers agree that plain status should show prior successful vector indexing from metadata and reserve live probing for `--deep`.

options.title: Require Live-Probe Wording
options.body: Revise the status output or JSON shape so metadata-backed indexed readiness is distinguishable from current-process sqlite-vec loadability before merge.

options.title: Pause For Replacement Fix
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and redirect this PR if maintainers want a different canonical status contract.

recommendation.title: Accept Metadata-Backed Fast Status
recommendation.body: Land this PR if maintainers agree that plain status should show prior successful vector indexing from metadata and reserve live probing for `--deep`.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is assigned on the live PR and has recent memory metadata/reindex migration history in the affected files.
